roles.description: A readable 2D pixel-art player character with movement, study, pause/rest, celebration, and return-as-mentor states that carry your full progression arc.
roles.label: Your student protagonist

roles.description: Animated 2D pixel-art characters for grandmother, mother, shopkeeper, the observing child, other role-bearing villagers, and the new student, with expressive dialogue and milestone-reaction poses.
roles.label: Your core villagers and new student

roles.description: Cozy pixel-art farms, homes, library, school, shop, computer center, clinic, electricity and internet structures, with clearly readable locked, basic, improved, and thriving states where applicable.
roles.label: Your interactive buildings and upgrades

roles.description: A cohesive top-down or three-quarter pixel-art environment kit for dirt and improved roads, farm plots, paths, boundaries, unlockable areas, and the central street-lamp setting.
roles.label: Your explorable village world

roles.description: Pixel-art study spaces, desk materials, books, and session-state visuals that make subject choice and start, pause, resume, and finish actions feel part of the village rather than a generic timer dashboard.
roles.label: Your integrated study experience

roles.description: Readable pixel-art day, night, weather, lighting, ambient activity, and village-improvement states that reflect progress without obscuring movement or interactions.
roles.label: Your living-world states

roles.description: A restrained pixel-art interface treatment for XP, player and village levels, session totals, daily and weekly statistics, consistency, study history, milestones, achievements, and gentle return messaging.
roles.label: Your progression and history interface

roles.description: Composed in-world pixel-art scenes for villagers remembering your beginnings, reacting to contributions, and the final street-lamp handoff: “You made it. Now it's your turn.”
roles.label: Your milestone narrative moments
